action.sql: select w, sum(esc) esc, sum(rep) rep, sum(comp) comp, sum(churn) churn, sum(visit) visit, sum(remote) remote from (select date_trunc('week',date) w, count(*) esc, 0 rep, 0 comp, 0 churn, 0 visit, 0 remote from escalation group by all union all select date_trunc('week',date), 0, count(*), 0,0,0,0 from repeat_call group by all union all select date_trunc('week',date), 0,0,count(*),0,0,0 from compensation group by all union all select date_trunc('week',date), 0,0,0,count(*),0,0 from customer_churn group by all union all select date_trunc('week',date), 0,0,0,0,count(*),0 from technician_visit group by all union all select date_trunc('week',date), 0,0,0,0,0,count(*) from remote_resolution group by all) group by w order by w
